Name: Medieval Farm Rearranger
Author: lamplight12347
Description:
[size=3]Being able to move farm buildings from your actual farm is a great idea however the only option you have is one that matches the vanilla colors.

Well no longer!! Now you can move buildings around your farm with a rustic-styled Rearranger![/size]

[u]Installation:

[/u][list]
[*][size=3]Have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿installed﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ installed[/size]
[*][size=3]Have the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720?tab=description]JSON Assets[/url]﻿ and installed[/size]
[*][size=3]Have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5142]Farm Rearranger[/url]﻿ installed[/size]
[*][size=3](Make sure to also have SpaceCore installed as it's required for the normal Rearraner mod)[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and unzip into your mod folder![/size]
[/list]
[u]Config Options:[/u]
[size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Option with a wooden roof[/size]
[*][size=3]Option with a tile roof[/size]
[*][size=3]Planning on working on more versions in the future![/size]
[/list][size=3]

All credit for original coding goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/3590100]CherryChain[/url]﻿ and original concept and art by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26223429?tab=about+me]cel10e[/url]﻿

<3 Special thanks to the kind people in the Stardew Valley discord for helping me with the coding <3[/size]
